name: Freeway
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The pledge platform Freeway tweeted, “The price of its token FWT fluctuated violently on July 13 and is currently under investigation. Freeway’s blockchain bridging service provider Coffe was attacked, and a large number of FWT tokens were bridged from Coffe. The Freeway platform was not compromised in any way, nor was Supercharger. However, Freeway has temporarily disabled FWT withdrawals, deposits, and purchases on the platform,” crypto influencer FatManTerra claimed on Twitter.
